summary: The Community edition now includes more of SecurityInsight, and its updates are checked before they install.

new.title: More features in the Community edition
new.text: Cross-engine correlation and full asset properties are now part of the Community edition. Asset tagging, verification and data health are in both editions.

new.title: Checked updates for the Community edition
new.text: A Community install updates from the SecurityInsight update channel. Every release is verified before anything is installed.

new.title: Smaller improvements
new.text: The Community edition shows its own logo in the web app, and version numbers are short.

fixes.title: Updates never overlap
fixes.text: An update never overlaps another one that is still running, and a running update keeps reporting its stage, so it never looks hung.

fixes.title: Failed data sync parts are reported
fixes.text: When part of the data sync fails, for example because the database is full, the run reports it as failed instead of finishing as if all was well.
